archiveTitle: 日报｜《The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel》正式定名

decisions.headline: itch.io上线生成式AI披露筛选，可按图像、代码与工具用途过滤
decisions.summary: itch.io在11月3日为搜索结果加入生成式AI披露筛选：用户既可按是否使用AI过滤，也可进一步区分图像、代码或工具等使用环节。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON 报道并引用itch.io的功能公告；本包未含itch.io完整一手页面，故按媒体转述官方信息发布。
decisions.reason: 可信媒体明确转述itch.io已上线的新搜索筛选功能，主体、时间与功能范围完整。
decisions.timeNote: 功能于11月3日上线，报道于北京时间11月4日09:29发布。

decisions.verification: IGN 报道已打开；未从正文反推主体身份。
decisions.reason: 主体身份门为 requires_subject_identity；同时这是婚礼现场的社交媒体趣闻，不构成游戏产品或产业层面的实质信息增量。

decisions.verification: IGN 报道已打开；未从正文反推 titleKey 或主体身份。
decisions.reason: 开发商道歉、移除账号福利并调整创作者合作审批流程具有行业治理增量，但 packet 将主体标记为 requires_subject_identity；需等待可信主体身份。

decisions.verification: IGN 商务导购页面已打开；按动态促销与主体身份规则排除。
decisions.reason: 主体身份门为 requires_subject_identity，且内容是依赖礼品卡与动态商店价格的促销导购，不进入新闻续编。

decisions.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
decisions.headline: Google为《塞尔达传说：时之笛》上线搜索彩蛋
decisions.summary: 在Google搜索“时のオカリナ”或“ゼルダの伝説”会出现与《塞尔达传说：时之笛》相关的互动彩蛋；报道指出其他部分系列副标题不会触发同一效果。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON 报道给出可识别的搜索词与触发结果；本包未含Google一手公告，故按媒体报道边界发布。
decisions.reason: 可信媒体清楚描述了Google搜索彩蛋的触发词与表现，构成窗口内的游戏文化观察。
decisions.timeNote: 报道于北京时间11月3日14:50发布。

versionsAndTerms: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

decisions.verification: Gematsu 报道已打开；未从正文反推 titleKey。
decisions.reason: PS5版11月17日发售是明确的信息增量，但 packet 将主体标记为 requires_subject_identity；按契约需等待采集层提供可信主体身份后再编。

entries.headline: itch.io adds generative-AI disclosure filters for search results
entries.summary: The new filters let users exclude or include projects based on whether they use AI and narrow results by where AI was used, including graphics, code, or tools.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports and quotes itch.io's feature announcement. The packet does not include the full first-party itch.io page, so this is published as a media relay of official information.
entries.timeNote: The feature launched on November 3; the report was published at 09:29 Beijing time on November 4.

entries.headline: Google adds a search Easter egg for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
entries.summary: Searching Google for "時のオカリナ" or "ゼルダの伝説" triggers an interactive Ocarina of Time-themed Easter egg. The report says several other Zelda subtitles do not trigger the same effect.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON identifies the search terms and resulting effect. The packet does not include a first-party Google announcement, so this remains a media report.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:50 Beijing time on November 3.
